blocks.text: In that age religion had grown thin while greed for wealth had become a form of deceit. Yet in that family a great one was born. (6)
The hour, the house, the constellation, and the conjunction were all auspicious. (7)
From the very moment of birth the parents felt a great radiance, as if wealth, siddhis, and divine favor had entered the house. (8)
The family rejoiced and summoned a learned pandit to examine the child’s destiny. (9–10)
The pandit declared that this child was no ordinary being but one destined to guide the world. (11)
